_note: This is a PROPOSAL, not the live registry. It must not be copied over docs/agents/TASK_REGISTRY.json directly. current_live_state reflects the real, current TASK_REGISTRY.json entry for CC-02I as of this revision (Revision 2, WF-CC02I-SPEC-R2). activation_target is the state this proposal asks ChatGPT to approve moving toward — it is not applied by this document and is not applied by any ticket in WF-CC02I-SPEC-R2. Moving from current_live_state to activation_target requires a separate, independently-authorized activation workflow (WF-CC02I-ACT-01, not yet created) after ChatGPT approves this revised spec and ticket package. The existing register-maintenance command is a generic maintenance-stage bootstrap mechanism (see docs/agents/DUAL_AGENT_PROTOCOL.md's 'Maintenance registration' section) — it cannot be used to unlock CC-02I itself, since CC-02I is a Product Stage, not a Maintenance Stage, and the same protocol explicitly states an agent cannot use maintenance registration to unlock a blocked Product Stage. Until WF-CC02I-ACT-01 is authorized, claimed, and completed, CC-02I remains claimable:false in the live registry, regardless of what this proposal's activation_target says. The single canonical Implementation Authorization Gate is docs/engineering/reviews/CC-02I-stage-gate-r2-review.md plus this file — CC-02I-stage-gate-review.md and CC-02I-stage-gate-r1-review.md are both Historical/Superseded and carry no gate authority (R2-01).
revision_context: Produced under WF-CC02I-SPEC-R2 in response to ChatGPT's REVISE AND RESUBMIT — Narrow Revision 2 verdict on the Revision 1 bundle (20260806-2107-cc02i-spec-r1-stage-gate.zip).
